metadata.name: Arctic Sediment Core Diatom Abundance and Species Composition (AMK75-6150)
metadata.description: Paleoceanographic dataset from a single sediment core (AMK75-6150) in the Arctic Fram Strait (74.78°N, 8.44°E). Contains 31 stratigraphic samples with total diatom abundance, ecological group percentages (warm, cold, ice-neritic, sea ice, sublittoral, freshwater, fossil), and relative abundance of 26 individual diatom species. Temporal context is provided by sediment depth and estimated age in thousands of years; calendar dates are not available.
metadata.temporal: Stratigraphic (sediment depth and estimated age in kyr)
